segments.thag2.45:1.1: “Na ukkhipe no ca parikkhipe pare, okkhipe pāragataṃ na eraye;
segments.thag2.45:1.3: Na cattavaṇṇaṃ parisāsu byāhare, anuddhato sammitabhāṇi subbato.
segments.thag2.45:2.3: Saṃsevitavuddhasīlinā, nibbānaṃ na hi tena dullabhan”ti.

lines: Evaṃ thero saṅkhepeneva dhammakathikalakkhaṇaṃ vatvā tesaṃ guṇānaṃ attani labbhamānataṃ adhimuccitvā bhiyyosomattāya abhippasannaṃ mahājanaṃ ñatvā “evaṃvidhassa dhammakathikassa vimuttāyatanasannissitassa na nibbānaṃ dullabhaṃ, atha kho sulabhamevā”ti dassento “susukhumanipuṇatthadassinā”ti dutiyagāthamāha.
